lines.zh: 铁爪踩进泥里，拔出来带着响声。
lines.en: My iron claws sink into the mud and come out with a sound.

lines.zh: 一群二十只，压得芦苇全弯了。
lines.en: Twenty of us in a flock bend every reed down.

lines.zh: 翅羽相碰，像一串断掉的铁片。
lines.en: Our wing feathers clatter like a string of broken iron plates.

lines.zh: 我先跳过这条水沟，泥太深。
lines.en: I hop this ditch first; the mud runs too deep.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水面被我们踩出一圈圈纹。
lines.en: We stamp rings of ripples across the swamp water.

lines.zh: 金属的腿很重，走一步陷一步。
lines.en: Metal legs are heavy; every step sinks a little.

lines.zh: 翅膀收在身侧，蹭出细碎的刮声。
lines.en: Wings folded at my sides, scraping out a thin rasp.

lines.zh: 前面的同伴落脚，我就跟着落。
lines.en: A flockmate lands ahead, so I land too.

lines.zh: 苇丛太密，我侧着身子挤过去。
lines.en: The reeds are thick; I squeeze through them sideways.

lines.zh: 泥水溅到金属羽毛上，一会儿就干。
lines.en: Mud splashes my metal feathers and dries in moments.

lines.zh: 我沿着那条旧堤走，才不陷得深。
lines.en: I take the old dike so I don't sink as deep.

lines.zh: 每只鸟的步子都一样，像敲铁。
lines.en: Every bird steps alike, like hammering on iron.

lines.zh: 翅膀张一下，泥点子甩出去老远。
lines.en: One wingbeat throws mud far off my feathers.

lines.zh: 前面的水洼反着光，我绕开了。
lines.en: The puddle ahead flashes; I go around it.

lines.zh: 我踩在浮泥上，陷到膝盖。
lines.en: I step on soft mud and sink to the knee.

lines.zh: 铁羽刮过苇秆，倒了一排。
lines.en: My iron feathers shear the reeds flat.

lines.zh: 我们在泥里排成一列走。
lines.en: We file through the mud in a line.

lines.zh: 抬脚的时候，泥拉出长丝。
lines.en: Lifting a foot draws the mud up in strings.

lines.zh: 我用喙梳理翅根，发出金属的响。
lines.en: I preen my wing joints with my beak; it rings of metal.

lines.zh: 整片沼泽安静，只有我们在磨喙。
lines.en: The whole swamp is still; only we scrape our beaks.

lines.zh: 翅膀底下那层铁色，越晒越亮。
lines.en: The iron sheen under my wings brightens in the sun.

lines.zh: 我在数自己的羽毛，少了一根。
lines.en: I'm counting my feathers; I'm short one.

lines.zh: 泥里的虫子不够塞牙，羽毛太硬。
lines.en: The bugs in the mud aren't enough, and my feathers are stiff.

lines.zh: 同伴落在我旁边，翅膀咔一声。
lines.en: A flockmate settles beside me; a wing clicks.

lines.zh: 沼泽上空的雾，把铁锈味压近了。
lines.en: The swamp fog presses the smell of rust close in.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进翅下，那里有点暖。
lines.en: I tuck my head under a wing, where it's a little warm.

lines.zh: 死水里有东西动，我盯了很久。
lines.en: Something moves in the stagnant water; I watch a long while.

lines.zh: 巢是铁羽编的，躺着不太舒服。
lines.en: My nest is woven of iron feathers; it isn't comfortable.

lines.zh: 我抖抖身子，羽毛互相磕得直响。
lines.en: I shake myself, and my feathers knock together loudly.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽的天空，一直是灰的。
lines.en: The sky over this swamp is always gray.

lines.zh: 你的弓弦响了，我听见了那声音。
lines.en: Your bowstring creaks; I heard that sound.

lines.zh: 抬起头，我盯住你手里的箭羽。
lines.en: I lift my head and fix on the feathers in your hand.

lines.zh: 你站在干岸上，我们都在泥里。
lines.en: You stand on dry ground; we are all in the mire.

lines.zh: 你把箭搭上弦，我不退。
lines.en: You nock an arrow; I don't back away.

lines.zh: 铁做的眼睛看不出情绪，只看方向。
lines.en: My iron eyes show nothing but direction.

lines.zh: 我们二十只一起转头，声音很齐。
lines.en: Twenty of us turn at once, perfectly in time.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁，和我有点像。
lines.en: You carry iron on you; we're a little alike.

lines.zh: 别把手伸过来，喙能咬断指骨。
lines.en: Don't reach out; my beak could snap a finger.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，是怕羽毛吗？
lines.en: You stepped back — is it the feathers you fear?

lines.zh: 我歪头，泥水从喙尖滴下来。
lines.en: I tilt my head; muddy water drips from my beak.

lines.zh: 一根羽毛被打弯了，我飞不直。
lines.en: A feather's been bent; I can't fly straight.

lines.zh: 铁片凹了一块，声音都变了。
lines.en: A plate is dented, and my voice has changed.

lines.zh: 我落到泥里，翅膀撑不起来。
lines.en: I drop into the mud; my wings won't lift me.

lines.zh: 你把我的羽毛打散了，很难接回去。
lines.en: You scattered my feathers; they're hard to set back.

lines.zh: 这一下打穿了翅膜，很疼。
lines.en: That blow punched through the wing membrane; it hurts.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，整群都听见了。
lines.en: I called once, and the whole flock heard.

lines.zh: 锈水渗进裂缝里，更难受。
lines.en: Rusty water seeps into the crack; worse than the blow.

lines.zh: 捡不起来的羽毛，就只能丢了。
lines.en: Any feather I can't retrieve is simply lost.

lines.zh: 我退到苇丛里，先修好翅根。
lines.en: I withdraw into the reeds to fix my wing joint.

lines.zh: 打我不划算，我身上没肉。
lines.en: Hitting me is a poor trade; there's no meat on me.

lines.zh: 你手里有铁屑的反光，我看见了。
lines.en: Iron filings flash in your hand; I've seen them.

lines.zh: 谁在敲铁？那声音我忍不住要跟。
lines.en: Who's striking iron? I can't help following that sound.

lines.zh: 水面下的鱼影一晃，我翅膀就张开。
lines.en: A fish shadow shifts below, and my wings open.

lines.zh: 同伴叫了一声，我就知道有东西吃。
lines.en: A flockmate calls once, and I know there's food.

lines.zh: 你抖那块布，我就当是猎物的动静。
lines.en: You flap that cloth; I take it for a stir of prey.

lines.zh: 锈的味道顺着风过来，我朝那边走。
lines.en: The smell of rust drifts in; I head that way.

lines.zh: 有东西在泥里动，我迈开腿。
lines.en: Something moves in the mud; I start walking.

lines.zh: 石头下面亮了一下，我去瞧瞧。
lines.en: A glint under that stone — I'll go look.

lines.zh: 你把箭丢下来，是给我的吗？
lines.en: You dropped an arrow — is that for me?

lines.zh: 羽毛立起来，我有点按不住。
lines.en: My feathers lift; I can barely hold still.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的翅根，铁片刮出火星。
lines.en: You hit my wing joint, and the plates throw sparks.

lines.zh: 两鸟在空中错不开，一起掉进泥。
lines.en: Two birds can't pass in the air and fall into the mud together.

lines.zh: 这身金属撞上来，比石头沉。
lines.en: This metal body hits harder than a stone.

lines.zh: 翅尖划到你的袖子，布开了道口。
lines.en: My wingtip catches your sleeve and opens a seam.

lines.zh: 你踩了苇根，我正好降落在那儿。
lines.en: You stepped on a reed root, right where I was landing.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，叮当作响。
lines.en: We crowd together with a clatter of metal.

lines.zh: 二十只鸟一起起飞，风都乱了。
lines.en: Twenty birds launch at once, and the wind turns messy.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞歪了我的羽毛。
lines.en: Your shoulder knocks one of my feathers askew.

lines.zh: 喙碰到了你的护腕，磕得很响。
lines.en: My beak raps your bracer with a hard clack.

lines.zh: 我没让开，泥地本来就窄。
lines.en: I didn't step aside; the mud path was already narrow.

lines.zh: 翅膀扫过芦苇，倒了一片。
lines.en: My wing sweeps the reeds and lays a patch flat.

lines.zh: 撞上我先退，你们铁的东西脾气大。
lines.en: Bump into me and I give way; you iron folk have tempers.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的一根羽毛递给她。
lines.en: I offer her the brightest feather I have.

lines.zh: 我们在苇丛深处把巢压得更实。
lines.en: Deep in the reeds we press the nest down firm.

lines.zh: 她的喙碰我的喙，叮的一声。
lines.en: Her beak touches mine with a small ring.

lines.zh: 铁羽铺在巢里，卵不会凉。
lines.en: Iron feathers line the nest so the eggs stay warm.

lines.zh: 我绕着她飞了一圈，翅膀收得慢。
lines.en: I circle her once, folding my wings slowly.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽够大，够养一窝小鸟。
lines.en: This swamp is wide enough to raise a clutch.

lines.zh: 她叫一声，我就把泥里的虫子叼来。
lines.en: She calls once, and I bring her the bugs from the mud.

lines.zh: 两根铁羽并排放着，像一对刀。
lines.en: Two iron feathers side by side, like a pair of blades.

lines.zh: 我们轮流守着巢，谁也不飞远。
lines.en: We take turns at the nest; neither flies far.

lines.zh: 成对之后，叫声短了，也低了。
lines.en: Paired now, our calls grow shorter and lower.

lines.zh: 我叼回自己射空的那根羽毛。
lines.en: I pick up the feather I shot wide.

lines.zh: 地上这根铁羽，还能再用一次。
lines.en: This iron feather on the ground can fly once more.

lines.zh: 我把羽毛插回翅下，顺序不能乱。
lines.en: I slot the feather back under my wing; the order matters.

lines.zh: 泥里那根弯了，我踩直它。
lines.en: That one in the mud is bent; I stamp it straight.

lines.zh: 这根断了尖，只能留着垫巢。
lines.en: This one broke at the tip; only good for the nest.

lines.zh: 我捡起它，翅根的空缺就补上了。
lines.en: I take it up, and the gap in my wing closes.

lines.zh: 你的箭掉在泥里，我拔出来看看。
lines.en: Your arrow fell in the mud; I pull it out to look.

lines.zh: 铁羽要轻拿，碰坏了就飞不直。
lines.en: Iron feathers must be handled gently, or they fly crooked.

lines.zh: 我一根一根数，收齐了才起飞。
lines.en: I count them one by one and launch only when complete.

lines.zh: 这根不是我的，但看着很像。
lines.en: This one isn't mine, though it looks very like one.

lines.zh: 你踩断了一根苇子，我听见了。
lines.en: You snapped a reed; I heard it.

lines.zh: 整群鸟同时抬头，就是盯上你了。
lines.en: The whole flock lifts its heads at once — that means you.

lines.zh: 你身上没护甲，羽毛能扎进去。
lines.en: You wear no armor; my feathers will sink in.

lines.zh: 我飞起来，从高处看你的破绽。
lines.en: I take off to study your openings from above.

lines.zh: 你走进沼泽，就没打算跑吧？
lines.en: You walked into the swamp — not planning to run?

lines.zh: 我盯住你的喉咙，那里没有铁。
lines.en: I fix on your throat; there's no iron there.

lines.zh: 风向对，我的羽毛能飞得很直。
lines.en: The wind is right; my feathers will fly straight.

lines.zh: 你举盾的样子，我记住了。
lines.en: I've noted the way you raise that shield.

lines.zh: 落单的人，最好下手。
lines.en: Someone alone makes the easiest mark.

lines.zh: 我绕到侧面，那里没有布挡着。
lines.en: I circle to your side, where no cloth covers you.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶盘旋，一圈比一圈低。
lines.en: I circle your head, lower with every turn.

lines.zh: 羽毛已经夹在爪间，随时能射。
lines.en: A feather is already in my claws, ready to fly.

lines.zh: 你往左，我就先一步飞到左边。
lines.en: You go left, and I'm already flying left.

lines.zh: 数到三，我就松爪。
lines.en: On three, I open my claws.

lines.zh: 你躲在苇子后面，我看得见脚。
lines.en: You hide behind the reeds, but I see your feet.

lines.zh: 同伴堵住了另一边，你别回头。
lines.en: A flockmate blocks the other side; don't look back.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在你脚边，很准。
lines.en: My shadow falls right at your feet.

lines.zh: 翅膀的角度调好了，等一个空当。
lines.en: I've set my wing angle; waiting for one gap.

lines.zh: 你喘得厉害，我的耐力还够。
lines.en: You're breathing hard; my stamina still holds.

lines.zh: 再挪半步，我就扑下来。
lines.en: Half a step more, and I drop on you.

lines.zh: 喙钉进你的肩，像敲进一枚钉子。
lines.en: My beak drives into your shoulder like a nail.

lines.zh: 我从侧面啄你的手，先把武器弄掉。
lines.en: I peck your hand from the side to drop your weapon.

lines.zh: 铁喙一合，你的袖子撕开了。
lines.en: My iron beak closes, and your sleeve tears open.

lines.zh: 爪子抓在你的背上，带起一块布。
lines.en: My claws catch your back and tear away cloth.

lines.zh: 我一跃，整只鸟撞在你胸口。
lines.en: One leap, and my whole body strikes your chest.

lines.zh: 喙尖找的是眼睛，你偏头躲开了。
lines.en: My beak goes for your eyes; you turn away.

lines.zh: 翅膀抽在你脸上，声音很脆。
lines.en: My wing cracks across your face, sharp and clean.

lines.zh: 你踢过来，我借势飞高了。
lines.en: You kick; I use the motion to rise higher.

lines.zh: 这一啄之后，我的喙上有血。
lines.en: After that peck, there's blood on my beak.

lines.zh: 你退到水里，我就不追了。
lines.en: You back into the water, and I stop chasing.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾还没散，我们已经在飞。
lines.en: The swamp fog hasn't lifted, and we're already flying.

lines.zh: 一群二十只，从芦苇里同时醒。
lines.en: Twenty of us wake together out of the reeds.

lines.zh: 头一只叫了，其余的跟着叫。
lines.en: The first one calls; the rest answer.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛在出生时就带着锈色。
lines.en: My feathers came into the world rust-colored.

lines.zh: 这片死水是我们的老地方。
lines.en: This stretch of dead water is our old ground.

lines.zh: 站在断掉的木桩上，我试试喙。
lines.en: Perched on a broken stump, I test my beak.

lines.zh: 翅膀第一次张开，声音像刀出鞘。
lines.en: My wings open for the first time, like a blade drawn.

lines.zh: 苇秆上落下三只，我们就成了群。
lines.en: Three land on the reeds, and we are a flock.

lines.zh: 泥水没过爪子，我却不觉得冷。
lines.en: Mud covers my claws, and I don't feel the cold.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片沼泽归我们巡。
lines.en: From today, we patrol this swamp.

lines.zh: 火把燎过羽毛，铁皮烫得发红。
lines.en: The torch licks my feathers and the iron glows red.

lines.zh: 从高处摔进泥里，翅膀先着地。
lines.en: I fall from height into the mud, wings first.

lines.zh: 翅膀进了水，沉得抬不起来。
lines.en: Water in my wings; they're too heavy to lift.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻了，羽毛乱飞。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, feathers scattering.

lines.zh: 你的箭擦过铁羽，溅出火星。
lines.en: Your arrow grazes my iron feathers and throws sparks.

lines.zh: 紫光让我的铁羽一阵发麻。
lines.en: Violet light leaves my iron feathers tingling.

lines.zh: 沼泽里虫子太少，我瘦得飞不动。
lines.en: Too few bugs in this swamp; I'm too thin to fly.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，铁羽全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and every iron feather lights up.

lines.zh: 这里没有风，我的翅膀派不上用。
lines.en: There's no wind here; my wings are useless.
